formula.pick: What is the chemical formula of {label}?
formula.match: Match each chemical to its formula.

rows.label: water
rows.description: chemical compound whose molecules are formed by two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom
rows.hook: covers most of the Earth's surface and is essential to every known form of life

rows.label: ethanol
rows.hook: is the intoxicating ingredient in beer, wine and spirits, and is also blended into fuel

rows.label: caffeine
rows.description: chemical compound used as a stimulant
rows.hook: is the stimulant in coffee, tea and energy drinks that keeps people awake

rows.label: hydrogen peroxide
rows.hook: is a pale blue liquid used to bleach hair and to bubble over minor cuts

rows.label: aspirin
rows.description: medication used to treat pain and decrease the risk of heart disease
rows.hook: is a common over-the-counter pill taken for headaches, fever and inflammation

rows.label: nitrous oxide
rows.hook: is known as laughing gas and was long used by dentists as an anaesthetic

rows.label: ammonia
rows.hook: is a gas with a sharp, choking smell found in many household cleaning products

rows.label: glucose
rows.description: simple sugar, or monosaccharide, with the chemical formula C6H12O6; also called dextrose, d-glucopyranose, cerelose, grape sugar, and corn sugar
rows.hook: is the simple sugar that cells burn for energy and that circulates in your blood

rows.label: carbon dioxide
rows.hook: is the gas people exhale and plants absorb, and it puts the fizz in soda

rows.label: hydrochloric acid
rows.description: highly corrosive, strong mineral acid in aqueous solution
rows.hook: is found in the human stomach, where it helps digest food

rows.label: sulfuric acid
rows.hook: is the corrosive fluid inside a car battery and one of the most produced industrial chemicals

rows.label: urea
rows.hook: is the main waste substance passed out of the body in pee, and was the first organic compound made in a lab

rows.label: benzene
rows.description: hydrocarbon compound consisting of a 6-sided ring
rows.hook: is a sweet-smelling, ring-shaped liquid found in petrol and known to cause cancer

rows.label: formaldehyde
rows.hook: is a pungent gas used to preserve biology specimens in jars

rows.label: hydrogen sulfide
rows.hook: is the gas that gives rotten eggs their awful smell

rows.label: methanol
rows.hook: is a toxic wood-derived alcohol used as antifreeze and solvent, and is never safe to drink

rows.label: chloroform
rows.hook: is a sweet-smelling liquid that old movies show being used to knock people out on a cloth

rows.label: glycerol
rows.hook: is a thick, sweet, syrupy liquid used in soaps, lotions and food

rows.label: citric acid
rows.hook: is the sour taste in lemons and limes and is used to flavour sweets and drinks

rows.label: methane
rows.description: simplest organic molecule with one carbon atom and four hydrogen
rows.hook: is the main gas in natural gas and is also produced by cows

rows.label: vitamin C
rows.description: water-soluble vitamin and antioxidant essential for collagen synthesis, immune function, and skin brightening
rows.hook: is the nutrient in oranges that prevents scurvy in sailors

rows.label: carbon monoxide
rows.hook: is an odourless, deadly gas from faulty heaters and car exhaust that home alarms warn about

rows.label: silicon dioxide
rows.hook: is the main ingredient of sand and quartz and is used to make glass

rows.label: ozone
rows.hook: forms a layer high in the sky that shields life from the sun's ultraviolet rays

rows.label: nitric acid
rows.hook: is a strong corrosive liquid once called aqua fortis and used to make fertilizers and explosives

rows.label: sulfur dioxide
rows.hook: is a pungent gas released by volcanoes and burning coal that causes acid rain

rows.label: phosphoric acid
rows.hook: is added to cola drinks to give them a tangy bite

rows.label: calcium chloride
rows.hook: is spread on icy roads in winter to melt the ice

rows.label: ethylene
rows.hook: is a gas that makes fruit ripen and is the raw material for the most common plastic
